#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>
#include <climits>

using namespace std;

const int MOD = 998244353;

vector<int> polyMultiply(const vector<int>& a, const vector<int>& b, int mod) {
    int lenA = a.size(), lenB = b.size();
    int resultSize = lenA + lenB - 1;
    int fftLen = 1;
    while (fftLen < resultSize) fftLen <<= 1;

    vector<double> reA(fftLen, 0.0);
    vector<double> imA(fftLen, 0.0);
    vector<double> reB(fftLen, 0.0);
    vector<double> imB(fftLen, 0.0);

    for (int i = 0; i < lenA; i++) {
        long long val = ((long long)a[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
        reA[i] = val & 0x7fff;
        imA[i] = val >> 15;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < lenB; i++) {
        long long val = ((long long)b[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
        reB[i] = val & 0x7fff;
        imB[i] = val >> 15;
    }

    performFFT(reA, imA, false);
    performFFT(reB, imB, false);

    vector<double> resRe(fftLen, 0.0);
    vector<double> resIm(fftLen, 0.0);
    vector<double> extraRe(fftLen, 0.0);
    vector<double> extraIm(fftLen, 0.0);

    double scaleFactor = 0.25 / fftLen;
    for (int i = 0; i < fftLen; i++) {
        int j = (fftLen - i) & (fftLen - 1);

        double a1r = (reA[i] + reA[j]) * 0.5;
        double a1i = (imA[i] - imA[j]) * 0.5;
        double a2r = (imA[i] + imA[j]) * 0.5;
        double a2i = (reA[j] - reA[i]) * 0.5;

        double b1r = (reB[i] + reB[j]) * 0.5;
        double b1i = (imB[i] - imB[j]) * 0.5;
        double b2r = (imB[i] + imB[j]) * 0.5;
        double b2i = (reB[j] - reB[i]) * 0.5;

        resRe[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r;
        resIm[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i;
        extraRe[i] = a1r * b2r - a1i * b2i + a2r * b1r - a2i * b1i;
        extraIm[i] = a1r * b2i + a1i * b2r + a2r * b1i + a2i * b1r;
    }

    performFFT(resRe, resIm, true);
    performFFT(extraRe, extraIm, true);

    vector<int> result(resultSize);
    for (int i = 0; i < resultSize; i++) {
        long long part1 = llround(resRe[i]);
        long long part2 = llround(extraRe[i]);
        long long part3 = llround(resIm[i]);
        result[i] = (int)((part1 + ((part2 % mod) << 15) + ((part3 % mod) << 30)) % mod);
    }
    return result;
}

void performFFT(vector<double>& re, vector<double>& im, bool inverse) {
    int n = re.size();
    int leadingZeros = __builtin_clz(n);
    int bitReverseShift = 32 - leadingZeros;
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        int j = __builtin_clz(i) == 32 ? 0 : (INT_MAX >> __builtin_clz(i)) >> (31 - __builtin_clz(i));
        j = __builtin_bswap32(i) >> bitReverseShift;
        if (i < j) {
            double temp = re[i]; re[i] = re[j]; re[j] = temp;
            temp = im[i]; im[i] = im[j]; im[j] = temp;
        }
    }

    for (int segment = 2; segment <= n; segment <<= 1) {
        int half = segment >> 1;
        vector<double> cosines(half);
        vector<double> sines(half);
        double angleStep = 2 * M_PI / segment * (inverse ? -1 : 1);
        for (int i = 0; i < half; i++) {
            cosines[i] = cos(i * angleStep);
            sines[i] = sin(i * angleStep);
        }

        for (int start = 0; start < n; start += segment) {
            for (int offset = 0; offset < half; offset++) {
                double cr = cosines[offset];
                double ci = sines[offset];
                double ur = re[start + offset];
                double ui = im[start + offset];
                double vr = re[start + offset + half] * cr - im[start + offset + half] * ci;
                double vi = re[start + offset + half] * ci + im[start + offset + half] * cr;

                re[start + offset] = ur + vr;
                im[start + offset] = ui + vi;
                re[start + offset + half] = ur - vr;
                im[start + offset + half] = ui - vi;
            }
        }
    }

    if (inverse) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            re[i] /= n;
            im[i] /= n;
        }
    }
}

class InputReader {
private:
    istream& inputStream;
    static const int BUFFER_SIZE = 1024;
    char buffer[BUFFER_SIZE];
    int bufferIndex, bufferSize;

public:
    InputReader(istream& is) : inputStream(is) {
        bufferIndex = 0;
        bufferSize = 0;
    }

    int read() {
        if (bufferSize == -1) throw runtime_error("EOF");
        if (bufferIndex >= bufferSize) {
            bufferIndex = 0;
            inputStream.read(buffer, BUFFER_SIZE);
            bufferSize = inputStream.gcount();
            if (bufferSize <= 0) return -1;
        }
        return buffer[bufferIndex++] & 0xff;
    }

    int nextInt() {
        int c;
        while ((c = read()) <= ' ') if (c == -1) throw runtime_error("EOF");
        int sign = 1;
        if (c == '-') { sign = -1; c = read(); }
        int num = 0;
        do {
            if (c < '0' || c > '9') throw runtime_error("Invalid number");
            num = num * 10 + c - '0';
            c = read();
        } while (c > ' ');
        return num * sign;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    InputReader in(cin);
    int n = in.nextInt();
    int k = in.nextInt();
    vector<int> base(10, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        base[in.nextInt()] = 1;
    }

    vector<int> ans = {1};
    int exp = n / 2;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) {
            ans = polyMultiply(ans, base, MOD);
        }
        base = polyMultiply(base, base, MOD);
        exp >>= 1;
    }

    long long sum = 0;
    for (int val : ans) {
        sum = (sum + (long long)val * val) % MOD;
    }
    cout << sum << endl;

    return 0;
}
